displayPattern: 7-segment display on a Trane S9V2 two-stage variable-speed furnace (Service Facts S9V2-SF-2A-EN): E13
meaning: Blower does not match the personality module: the motor horsepower or OEM identification differs from the value programmed on the module.
causes: Personality module model and serial number do not match the furnace nameplate
Blower motor horsepower does not match the nameplate
diySteps: Leave the blower panel on until a technician compares the parts with the nameplate. The chart starts by disconnecting electrical power

Technician: if the personality module model and serial do not match the nameplate, replace the module with the correct one. If the blower motor horsepower does not match the nameplate, replace the motor with the correct horsepower
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. E13 is a mismatch between the motor, the personality module, and the nameplate.
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
